purpose: To showcase and describe all available weapons in VALORANT, categorized by their type and highlighting their unique characteristics.
summary: This page provides a detailed overview of the VALORANT arsenal, listing each weapon by its type (Sidearms, SMGs, Shotguns, Rifles, Snipers, Heavies, Melee) and offering a brief description of its combat utility and style. The primary call to action encourages users to 'PLAY NOW'.
